Description: Never backs down from a challenge, even against the odds
Always asking questions and poking around where they shouldn't
Motivated by wealth and always looking for the next payout
Fiercely devoted to friends and allies, even at personal cost
Uses humour and wit to deflect serious situations
Acts first and thinks later, often getting into trouble
Weighs every decision carefully before acting
Quick to help those in need, sometimes to a fault
Believes they are always the smartest person in the room
Values the truth above tact or comfort
Distrustful of strangers and quick to suspect betrayal
Stays upbeat and optimistic no matter the situation
Holds grudges and will go out of their way to settle scores
Rarely shows emotion, preferring calm logic over feeling
Naturally likeable and persuasive in conversation
Believes strongly in omens, luck, and old rituals
Driven to rise in power, status, or renown
Trusts too easily and struggles to see deception
Constantly irritated and quick to complain
Thoughtful and measured, often sought out for advice
